notes.title: Beardy the Digger is released!
notes.content:
Beardy the Digger is ready, hell yeah!

Through all the production hell, game is shipped and you can purchase it in store and play!
Feel free to share your thoughts, any bugs you'll experience since all of them will be fixed eventually with the mention of a bug's founder.

Good luck and see you in game!

notes.title: Beardy the Digger will be delayed for one week
notes.content:
[b]Hello, guys![/b]

The game release will be delayed for one week due to Valve checking the build. If the required time will be less than 7 days I'll press the [release] button sooner.

Thank you for your patience!
